basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Munich, Germany, who recently started exploring the world of custom PC building. I work as a junior graphic designer and love anything related to digital art and gaming. Mostly, you'll find me online during the evenings after work, diving into gaming or watching tutorials. I'm single and often spend weekends trying out new indie games or attending local tech meetups.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied it in university. My interest in technology is mostly self-taught through online tutorials and community forums. I recently started learning about PC building to enhance my gaming and design experience.
